An kasa saita Mamallakin Na\'ura. Tabbatar babu asusu a na\'urar.
An kasa saita Mamallakin Bayanin Martaba. Duba tsarin saitunan na\'urarka.
Don Allah kunna Shizuku kuma ba da izinin da aka nema
Wannan sanarwa ce ta DhizukuF don tabbatar da samuwar sabis a kowane lokaci. Za ka iya dannawa na tsawon lokaci don ɓoye wannan sanarwa.
Gudanar da umarnin Mamallakin Na\'ura daga kowace tasha (Termux, adb shell da sauransu), kamar rish na Shizuku. Fitar da fayilolin dish da dish_dhizukuf.dex sannan ka fara dish.
An kasa fitar da fayilolin dish

Kwafa fayilolin biyu zuwa babban fayil da tashar ka za ta iya gudanar da rubutun umarni, sannan ka fara dish:

Termux (gudanar da termux-setup-storage sau ɗaya):
cp /sdcard/PATH_TO_FOLDER/dish* $PREFIX/bin/
chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/dish
dish help

adb (daga kwamfuta):
adb push dish dish_dhizukuf.dex /data/local/tmp/
adb shell sh /data/local/tmp/dish help

Duk wata tasha: sh /path/to/dish help

Ka tsare fayilolin biyu tare. A gudanarwa ta farko, DhizukuF zai nemi ka amince da shiga, kamar kowace manhaja. Yawancin umarni suna buƙatar DhizukuF ya zama Mamallakin Na'ura (tallafin Mamallakin Bayanin Martaba yana da iyaka).
Yana ƙara maɓallin Toshe a taga tabbatarwa, don a iya toshe manhaja nan take
Yana alamta tashoshin da ke amfani da dish, misali Termux (dish), a taga tabbatarwa da kuma sarrafa manhajoji. Idan an kashe, Termux kaɗai ake nunawa
Bari tashoshi su yi amfani da na\'urar umarni ta Mamallakin Na\'ura (dish)
DhizukuF bai riga ya zama Mamallakin Na\'ura ko Mamallakin Bayanin Martaba ba, don haka dish zai ƙi umarni. Fara kunna DhizukuF tukuna. Har yanzu za ka iya fitar da fayilolin dish.
Yanayin Mamallakin Bayanin Martaba: dish yana aiki, amma umarnin da ke buƙatar cikakken Mamallakin Na\'ura (reboot, adb, timezone, DNS na sirri da sauransu) ba su samuwa.

dish ba tasha ba ce a cikin wannan manhaja, kayan aikin layin umarni ne: fitar da fayilolin, sannan ka gudanar da dish a manhajar tasha, zai fi kyau a Termux.

1. Danna «Fitar da fayilolin dish» ka zaɓi babban fayil.
2. A Termux gudanar da termux-setup-storage sau ɗaya, kwafa dish da dish_dhizukuf.dex zuwa $PREFIX/bin sannan ka gudanar da chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/dish.
3. Rubuta dish don buɗe na'urar umarni, ko dish help don ganin umarnin.

A gudanarwa ta farko, DhizukuF zai nemi ka amince da shiga.
Yana ba da damar ayyuka masu haɗari ga dish da API na Dhizuku: sake kunnawa, share bayanan manhaja, rubuta saituna, canza izini, kiran API kai tsaye da makamantansu. A kashe yake ta tsohuwa.

Yana bari manhajojin da aka rubuta don Dhizuku na asali su yi amfani da DhizukuF. Yana shigar da ƙaramin plugin da aka ɓoye (com.rosan.dhizuku) wanda aka sanya wa hannu da maɓalli ɗaya kuma nau\'i ɗaya da DhizukuF. DhizukuF na iya rufewa bayan shigarwa; sake buɗe shi.
An shigar da wani Dhizuku (com.rosan.dhizuku). Cire shi tukuna.
